items.source: Executable jars can be built using the bootJar task. The task is automatically created when the java plugin is applied and is an instance of BootJar. The assemble task is automatically configured to depend upon the bootJar task so running assemble (or build) will also run the bootJar task.
items.translation: 可以使用 `bootJar` 任务构建可执行的 jar 包。当应用 java 插件时，会自动创建该任务，它是 BootJar 的一个实例。assemble 任务会自动配置为依赖于 bootJar 任务，因此运行 assemble（或 build）也会执行 bootJar 任务。

items.source: Executable wars can be built using the bootWar task. The task is automatically created when the war plugin is applied and is an instance of BootWar. The assemble task is automatically configured to depend upon the bootWar task so running assemble (or build) will also run the bootWar task.
items.translation: 可以使用 `bootWar` 任务构建可执行的 war 包。当应用 `war` 插件时会自动创建该任务，它是 BootWar 的一个实例。assemble 任务会自动配置为依赖于 bootWar 任务，因此运行 assemble（或 build）也会执行 bootWar 任务。

items.source: By default, when the bootJar or bootWar tasks are configured, the jar or war tasks are configured to use plain as the convention for their archive classifier. This ensures that bootJar and jar or bootWar and war have different output locations, allowing both the executable archive and the plain archive to be built at the same time.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当配置了 bootJar` 或 `bootWar` 任务时，`jar` 或 `war` 任务会被配置为使用 `plain` 作为其归档分类器约定。 这确保了 `bootJar` 和 `jar` 或 `bootWar` 和 `war 具有不同的输出位置，从而允许同时构建可执行归档和普通归档。

items.source: The intoLayer closure claims content using nested include and exclude calls. The application closure uses Ant-style path matching for include/exclude parameters. The dependencies section uses group:artifact[:version] patterns. It also provides includeProjectDependencies() and excludeProjectDependencies() methods that can be used to include or exclude project dependencies.
items.translation:
`intoLayer` 闭包使用嵌套的 `include` 和 `exclude` 调用来声明内容。
`application` 闭包对包含/排除参数使用 Ant 风格的路径匹配。
`dependencies` 部分使用 `group:artifact[:version]` 模式。
它还提供了 `includeProjectDependencies()` 和 `excludeProjectDependencies()` 方法，可用于包含或排除项目依赖项。

items.source: By default, the bootJar task builds an archive that contains the application’s classes and dependencies in BOOT-INF/classes and BOOT-INF/lib respectively. Similarly, bootWar builds an archive that contains the application’s classes in WEB-INF/classes and dependencies in WEB-INF/lib and WEB-INF/lib-provided. For cases where a docker image needs to be built from the contents of the jar, it’s useful to be able to separate these directories further so that they can be written into distinct layers.
items.translation: 默认情况下，`bootJar` 任务构建的归档文件包含应用程序类（位于 `BOOT-INF/classes`）和依赖项（位于 `BOOT-INF/lib`）。同样，`bootWar` 构建的归档文件包含应用程序类（位于 `WEB-INF/classes`）以及依赖项（位于 `WEB-INF/lib` 和 `WEB-INF/lib-provided`）。对于需要从 jar 文件内容构建 Docker 镜像的情况，能够进一步分离这些目录以便将它们写入不同的层是非常有用的。

items.source: Looking at the dependencies closure in the example above, we can see that the first intoLayer will claim all project dependencies for the application layer. The next intoLayer will claim all SNAPSHOT dependencies for the snapshot-dependencies layer. The third and final intoLayer will claim anything left (in this case, any dependency that is not a project dependency or a SNAPSHOT) for the dependencies layer.
items.translation: 查看上面的示例中的 dependencies` 闭包，我们可以看到第一个 `intoLayer` 将声明所有属于 `application` 层的项目依赖。 下一个 `intoLayer` 将声明所有属于 `snapshot-dependencies` 层的 SNAPSHOT 依赖。 第三个也是最后一个 `intoLayer` 将声明剩余的任何内容（在这种情况下，任何不是项目依赖或 SNAPSHOT 的依赖）用于 `dependencies 层。

items.source: The BootJar and BootWar tasks are subclasses of Gradle’s Jar and War tasks respectively. As a result, all of the standard configuration options that are available when packaging a jar or war are also available when packaging an executable jar or war. A number of configuration options that are specific to executable jars and wars are also provided.
items.translation: BootJar 和 BootWar 任务分别是 Gradle 的 Jar` 和 `War 任务的子类。因此，在打包可执行 jar 或 war 时，所有可用于打包普通 jar 或 war 的标准配置选项也同样可用。此外，还提供了一些专门针对可执行 jar 和 war 的配置选项。

items.source: The layers order is important as it determines how likely previous layers can be cached when part of the application changes. The default order is dependencies, spring-boot-loader, snapshot-dependencies, application. Content that is least likely to change should be added first, followed by layers that are more likely to change.
items.translation: 层顺序很重要，因为它决定了当应用程序的一部分发生变化时，前一层被缓存的可能性。默认顺序为 dependencies`、`spring-boot-loader`、`snapshot-dependencies` 和 `application。最不可能变化的内容应首先添加，随后是更可能变化的层。

items.source: Nested intoLayer closures are used within application and dependencies sections to claim content for a layer. These closures are evaluated in the order that they are defined, from top to bottom. Any content not claimed by an earlier intoLayer closure remains available for subsequent ones to consider.
items.translation: 嵌套的 intoLayer` 闭包用于在 `application` 和 `dependencies` 部分中声明层内容。这些闭包的评估顺序与其定义顺序一致，从上到下执行。任何未被较早的 `intoLayer 闭包声明的内容，仍可供后续的闭包考虑。

items.source: The application closure has similar rules. First claiming org/springframework/boot/loader/** content for the spring-boot-loader layer. Then claiming any remaining classes and resources for the application layer.
items.translation: `application` 闭包具有类似的规则。首先声明 `org/springframework/boot/loader/**` 的内容为 `spring-boot-loader` 层，然后声明任何剩余的类和资源为 `application` 层。

items.translation: 如果已应用了application插件，则必须配置其mainClass属性，并可用于相同的目的：

items.translation: 为了获得更精细的控制，也可以使用闭包。该闭包接收一个 FileTreeElement` 作为参数，并应返回一个 `boolean 值，以指示是否需要解压缩。

items.translation: 要使用 PropertiesLauncher` 启动可执行的 jar 或 war，请配置任务的清单以设置 `Main-Class 属性：

items.translation: dependencies 适用于任何版本不包含 SNAPSHOT 的非项目依赖。

items.source: snapshot-dependencies for any non-project dependency whose version contains SNAPSHOT.
items.translation: snapshot-dependencies 用于任何版本包含 SNAPSHOT 的非项目依赖。

items.source: The plugin can create executable archives (jar files and war files) that contain all of an application’s dependencies and can then be run with java -jar.
items.translation: 该插件可以创建包含应用程序所有依赖项的可执行归档文件（jar 文件和 war 文件），然后使用 java -jar 运行它们。

items.source: This ensures that the runtime jars are packaged in the war file’s WEB-INF/lib-provided directory from where they will not conflict with the external container’s own classes.
items.translation: 这确保了运行时 jar 被打包到 war 文件的 WEB-INF/lib-provided 目录中，从而不会与外部容器自身的类发生冲突。

items.source: By default, the executable archive’s main class will be configured automatically by looking for a class with a public static void main(String[]) method in the main source set’s output.
items.translation: 默认情况下，可执行归档的主类将通过在主源集的输出中查找具有 public static void main(String[]) 方法的类来自动配置。

items.source: By default all dependencies declared in the developmentOnly configuration will be excluded from an executable jar or war.
items.translation: 默认情况下，developmentOnly 配置中声明的所有依赖将从可执行 jar 或 war 中排除。

items.source: Most libraries can be used directly when nested in an executable archive, however certain libraries can have problems. For example, JRuby includes its own nested jar support which assumes that jruby-complete.jar is always directly available on the file system.
items.translation: 大多数库在嵌套于可执行归档中时可以直接使用，但某些库可能会出现问题。例如，JRuby 包含其自身的嵌套 jar 支持，该支持假定 jruby-complete.jar 始终直接存在于文件系统中。

items.translation: spring-boot-loader 用于 jar 加载器类。

items.source: application for project dependencies, application classes, and resources.
items.translation: application 用于项目依赖、应用程序类和资源。

With this jar on the classpath, you can launch your application in a special mode which allows the bootstrap code to run something entirely different from your application, for example, something that extracts the layers. items.source: The layered DSL is defined using three parts:
items.translation: layered DSL 使用三个部分定义：

items.source: The application closure defines how the application classes and resources should be layered.
items.translation: application 闭包定义了应用程序类与资源的分层方式。

items.source: The dependencies closure defines how dependencies should be layered.
items.translation: dependencies 闭包定义了依赖项的分层方式。

items.source: The layerOrder method defines the order that the layers should be written.
items.translation: layerOrder 方法定义了图层应写入的顺序。

items.source: If no include call is made, then all content (not claimed by an earlier closure) is considered.
items.translation: 如果没有调用 include，则所有内容（未被更早的闭包声明）均会被考虑。

items.source: If no exclude call is made, then no exclusions are applied.
items.translation: 如果没有调用exclude，则不会应用任何排除项。

items.source: The order that intoLayer closures are added is often different from the order that the layers are written. For this reason the layerOrder method must always be called and must cover all layers referenced by the intoLayer calls.

items.source: providedRuntime is preferred to Gradle’s compileOnly configuration as, among other limitations, compileOnly dependencies are not on the test classpath so any web-based integration tests will fail.
